section_summary.extract_value: This section describes a study examining the factor structure of the BAS-2 (Body Appreciation Scale-2) in a university sample in Hong Kong. The study aims to establish cross-cultural invariance of the BAS-2 and investigates associations between body appreciation and BMI in women and men, as well as associations with weight discrepancy, self-esteem, and life satisfaction. The researchers hypothesize negative correlations between body appreciation and BMI/weight discrepancy, and positive correlations with self-esteem and life satisfaction.
